messages:
Noah: Whos up for a sleepy 6pm parkrun meetup this Friday? short 3k loop, coffee after. weather says dry. :sun_behind_small_cloud:
Sasha: 6pm works! is it the riverside loop or the hill one? I vote flat.
Imani: Riversides for me. hill on Fridays is basically a confession booth for my quads. :joy:
Rory: I'll join if someone can carry my spare pair of running shoes. forgot mine last week (nooooo).
Noah: I have one extra pair (men's 9) — ok to loan?
Sasha: shoes check: do they need sticky grip or light trainers? I'm bringing trail shoes but could swap.
Rory: Any shoe helps. also FYI i may sprint the last 200m for ego points. fair warning.
Imani: tiny prize: first at the coffee table gets the last cinnamon cookie. stakes are high. :cookie:
Noah: also quick poll: chalk or no-chalk for post-run stretching? i have chalk in bag (for finger tips, not relevant)
Sasha: chalk = no, unless you're climbing immediately after. We're runners not gymnasts. :laughing:
Imani: Chalk for triathletes only. but bring a tiny first-aid kit. last time someone had a blister meltdown.
knees-bot: knees-bot: Reminder set for Fri 5:45pm. Reply "run" in thread to RSVP. If you have knee concerns DM me "scale" for modifications.
Rory: run
Sasha: run (bringing trail shoes as spare)
Imani: run (will be 10% power-walk 90% run depending on evening)
Noah: RSVP: run + spare shoebox (mock)
Sasha: FYI parking by the fountain is limited, come early or bike.
Imani: And towel + warm top for after — riverside breeze is merciless at dusk.
Noah: I'll post meetup pin + tiny map. See y'all Friday. may the best cookie-evolver win. :trophy:
